title: plugin-security: the platform-admin promotion WITHHELD warning still points the operator at the organization-ownership migration, which 18.0 refuses on every database (#24637, domain:services row 2)
body:
Filing gate **④**: a per-lane child of the coordination parent #24637 (the 18.0 release text family). Each row is ①'s release-text exception. The row comes from the `domain:services` family addendum `6279314663`, item 1 (#24652's dev, PR #24679). ## Row (read on `origin/main` `8e14ce0574`)

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts:880–883` is the boot warning "[security] platform-admin promotion WITHHELD: …". It ends: "The organization-ownership migration's id-to-name rewrite (ADR-0131 D10) names it; the next pass after that reads it by name." In 18.0 that migration refuses plan and apply on every database (`ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE`).

**Done:** the warning says what 18.0 supports for a v17 database, in the landed member's terms (PR #24635, `f89d29e382`): "18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path." Alternatively, it carries an 18.x qualifier where it describes the future rewrite. Pin the text. It is text only, and the withholding does not move.

**Order note.** PR #24681 (#24581, 18.x steps 5–6, draft) reopens the ceremony. When it lands, it re-states the surfaces #24635 taught, and this line joins them.

## Dedupe

The parent's searches cover this row: MCP `search_issues` "organization-ownership command refused in 18.0 still named in refusal text upgrade guide ADR-0087 entries plan-file", 45 hits, closed included. None covers this warning, and the addendum found it outside the parent's census spelling.
